newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products- gasoline strong, heating less so.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products- gasoline strong, heating less so.

text.p: NWE oil products were strong, although heating oil was under some pressure.
Gasoline barges shot up $9 to trade at $224 a tonne fob ARA late in the day, supported by good demand and NYMEX futures.
Naphtha was firmer with good demand for paraffinic material.
Heating oil came under some pressure from rising supply, including cargoes from the U.S., the Red Sea and the Mediterranean, but diesel premiums jumped on strong demand.
Fuel oil was firm on the back of tight supply and crude, but some talk was overinflated. Barges traded at $122-123 fob ARA, but cargo offers of $126 cif were rejected by a potential buyer.
